source_text: Capite nobis vulpes pusillas exterminantes vineas; et vineae nostrae florebunt. Sponsus ad sodales: vulpes florem vinearum insidiantur. In anima vulpes = potestates contrariae et cogitationes pravae; angeli capiant dum pusillae, ante consensum.
pass_a_gloss: Catch for-us foxes little destroying vineyards; and vineyards our will-flower. Bridegroom to companions: foxes flower of-vineyards lie-in-wait-for. In soul foxes = powers contrary and thoughts crooked; angels may-catch while little, before consent.
pass_b_english: [[Catch us the little foxes that spoil the vineyards; and our vineyards will flower >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:15]]. The Bridegroom to his companions: foxes lie in wait for the vineyards’ flower. In the soul foxes are contrary powers and crooked thoughts; angels are to catch them while little, before consent.
